script_text: Pisces and Gemini look easy—until feelings become a debate. Pisces is Water, ruled by Jupiter and Neptune; Gemini is Air, ruled by Mercury. Complementary, but depth can choke freedom. Pisces's Venus wants closeness; Gemini's Mars wants flirtation and freedom, so tenderness can feel controlling and distance can feel cruel. Uranus in Gemini opposes Pisces's 7th-house axis, while Saturn in Pisces occupies Gemini's 7th: attraction is instant, but commitment is fragile. Mercury in Scorpio activates Gemini's 6th house and Pisces's 3rd, making routine messages feel like interrogations. Gemini hears facts; Pisces hears subtext, so silence means betrayal. Jupiter in Leo sextiles Saturn in Pisces, supporting career and money in Gemini's 3rd and Pisces's 6th through teaching, writing, or advising. It lasts if Gemini's 7th-house Saturn gets kept promises and shared budgets; otherwise Pisces retreats. Put dates, money, and emotional needs in writing before conflict. Comment your partner's sign!
